purpose: complete exploratory method/subject/seed/control matrix with explicit finite training coverage

training.trainable: original projector plus LoRA q/v r8 alpha16 dropout0; frozen NF4 LLaVA7B and released BrainX
training.qa_selection: deterministic seed/trial selection among all available questions, identical acrossmethods

p3.consume: all trials in deterministic10% TRAIN image-group subset, one saved QA per trial, one pass
p3.max_updates: ceil(selected_trials/16), including correctly scaled partial final window
p3.scope_note: P3 consumes its entire selected subset; it does not inherit the256example cap

candidate_policy.selection: deterministic uniform samples without replacement from subject TRAIN image bank, independent of brain/true image/answer
candidate_policy.posterior_scope: conditional on sampled gallery; no true-target NLL if target not in support

evaluation.performance_gates: diagnostics only; continue all runs regardless of accuracy/NDG gains
evaluation.coverage_note: 128category-stratified testimages; not exhaustive full-test or full-training-data benchmark

compute_evidence.pilot_scope: one-update engineering timing only; CE/NPP/DAPD finite nonzero updates

storage.checkpoint_policy: latest atomic resumable trainables+optimizer+RNG/cursor only perrun; no frozenbase duplication

brainjanus: complete verified backend/checkpoint still release-dependent; continue all available backend runs
